questions.prompt: The Rosetta Stone dates from the reign of which dynasty?
questions.fact: That dynasty was Greek-speaking, which is why a Greek translation appeared on an Egyptian decree at all.

questions.prompt: Which planet has the most extreme temperature difference between day and night?
questions.fact: It swings roughly 600 degrees Celsius, because it has essentially no atmosphere to retain heat.

questions.prompt: How many gates does a slalom skier typically pass through?
questions.fact: Skiers deliberately knock the poles aside with arms and shins, which is why they wear shin and hand guards.

questions.prompt: Which streaming series follows a chess prodigy in the 1960s?
questions.fact: Chess set sales and online play both surged worldwide in the weeks after it aired.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Gobi Desert's southern portion?
questions.fact: It is expanding southward, and China has planted a vast belt of trees to try to slow it.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Bathsheba Everdene?
questions.fact: The surname was borrowed for the heroine of The Hunger Games as a deliberate nod.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym HDR improve in photography?
questions.fact: It works by combining several exposures, which is why moving subjects can produce ghosting.
